title: Harem Syndrome
paragraphs: “Nano, nano, nano! That’s right! A fight is unavoidable, nano!”
“Is that so?”
“Of course, nano!”
It’s extremely frustrating that we agree on something, but there’s no helping it.
“That’s right! This guy! Rival is an unavoidable enemy for me!”
However, I’ve already made my move!
“It’s too late now, Rival!”
I pointed my spear at Rival. That’s right. Rival, the outcome you desire most is no longer possible.
“Father has already done it with Older Sister, so he’s not a virgin anymore!”
“…Huh?”
Father, Ren, Itsuki, big sister, and her friend all stood there, mouths agape in shock. They all looked utterly astonished.
“Oh my, what do you mean by that?”
“That thing is after Father’s love—no, his virginity! But since Father’s virginity has already been taken by big sister, my victory is assured!”
“Guh… I had already considered the possibility of being outmaneuvered, nano. That’s why Gaelion decided to awaken a new fetish to compensate, nano!”
“What!? What are you aiming for now!?”
He’s taking an unexpected approach! To think he would come up with something beyond my predictions after all my interference… What is he plotting now!?
“Fufu, Gaelion thought of it, nano. If the orca woman got ahead of me, there’s still one thing that definitely wouldn’t have been taken yet…”
Rival leaned back arrogantly and declared:
“That would be Naofumi’s maidenhood, nano!”
Impossible… To even think of taking a man’s maidenhood… This guy is absolutely insane! Ren and Itsuki, who had been listening to our exchange, quietly distanced themselves from Father.
“It looks like a very powerful force is about to join us. And it seems to love Naofumi-san from the bottom of its heart. A harem indeed, Naofumi-san.”

“I’m honestly jealous. Compared to that, my troubles seem so trivial. Just watching Naofumi is enough to satisfy me. I’ve never actually experienced it, but… this must be what they call a dating sim.”
“Whoa! Ren, Itsuki! Don’t move away! Don’t leave me behind!”
“Don’t come near us. The harem might be contagious.”
“It’s not a disease!”
While Father and the others carried on, I was trembling in shock.
“Oh my, that’s wonderful, Naofumi-chan.”
“Guh… If it can’t take Father’s virginity, now he’s after his maidenhood… How should I stop this!?”
It seems that the only option left is to destroy him! But judging from its words, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to assume that it could use the power of the Lust & Envy Spear as its last resort.
“Then I guess I’ll settle for being second.”
“…Huh?”
…What did she just say!? I instinctively turned to stare at Father. He had a look that said, “What are you talking about, big sister?”
“Father!? Are you still a virgin!? You didn’t do it with big sister!?”
“Don’t say it out loud! It’s embarrassing!”
“Nano!? This is a huge opportunity, nano!”
Rival clasps its hands together, and I feel like I can see hearts floating in its eyes! No way… Could it be that Father is still a virgin!?
“Why is Father still a virgin!? Didn’t he do it with Older Sister!?”
“Well, there were times when things got close!”
Father glanced quickly toward Big Sister. No… way…!? Could it be that he couldn’t enjoy it because of Big Sister’s crying at night!?
“There’s no choice! Big Sister… no, even her friend is fine! Someone has to take Father’s virginity and maidenhood right here!”
“What kind of instructions are those!? Stop saying weird things!”
“Don’t let this chance slip away, nano!”
“Naofumi-san!?”
“Is someone really about to forcefully take Naofumi’s virginity!?”
“This looks like it’s about to turn into a ridiculous scene!”
Ren and Itsuki started getting restless. Seeing their reactions, Father shouted in a loud voice.
“Why do you two look so excited? Help me out here!”
After puffing out its chest proudly, Rival began casting magic on himself.
“This is magic I learned last time when I became a Dragon Emperor. So, I don’t need to defeat the Dragon Emperor of Faubrey to do this, nano.”
Rival shrank down and took on the form of a human… That figure… it had the aura of a mature woman, vaguely resembling big sister. Wings sprouted from its back.
“Come on, Naofumi. Gaelion will protect you, nano. Just rely on me, nano.”

Saying that, Rival tried to entwine himself around Father’s arm. He seems slightly surprised by the transformation, but… Guh, that damn Rival! He deliberately altered its height to match Father’s preferences!
“Don’t worry. No matter what danger comes, Gaelion will protect Naofumi, nano. From now on, we’ll always be together! Gaelion loves Naofumi, nano!”
Rival is blatantly trying to make Father touch its chest.
“Eh? Ah? Um?”
“Oh my… Then I’ll be next.”
“Second place is acceptable, nano!”
Guh… Come to think of it, big sister isn’t picky about these things!
“Come on, let’s hurry back to Naofumi’s house, nano! The real battle is just beginning. This time, Gaelion will definitely win Naofumi’s heart, nano!”
“Ah, so the ‘battle’ is heading in that direction after all.”
“Well, at least we’ve gained another ally safely.”
“Why does this feel so unsettling!?”
Big sister tilted her head. Then, her friend approached Rival from behind and gently stroked its tail, which hadn’t changed even after taking human form.
“Nano!? W-What is it?”
“I’m Rifana. Gaelion… is that what I should call you? You really love Naofumi-sama, don’t you?”
“That’s right! I will definitely make Naofumi mine, nano. Nice to meet you, nano.”
“I-I understand what you’re saying, but what about your father and big sister? Aren’t you going to bring them along?”
“It’s fine, nano! They’re happier living peacefully deep in the mountains, away from the conflict.”
“Well… I guess that’s one way to think about it. What about Ren?”
“No problem! Just don’t drag me into this. I want to stay uninvolved.”
“Help me out here! Ren! Itsuki!”
With so much emotion packed into those few words, Father tried to move closer to the two of them for help. And yet, am I not here? Guh… This is infuriating!
“Big sister! You need to show some spirit! Just like in the last loop, you need to take Father’s virginity first!”
“Oh my… But I don’t really care whether Naofumi-chan is a virgin or not, you know?”
“I’m the one who can’t accept that!”
Guh… Big sister is impossible to deal with. In that case, I’ll go for a preemptive strike!
“Brio—”
Rival quickly grabbed my spear and redirected its aim, all while flashing a grin.
“Shooting me is pointless, nano. I’ll definitely endure it, and even if I’m killed, I’ll just regenerate right away, nano.”
D-Damn it! Now, the strongest enemy has stood in my way!

“The Spear Hero probably hasn’t told you yet, so I’ll reintroduce myself, nano. Gaelion became a Dragon Emperor in the previous loop, nano. If I can just take the core stone from the dragon in Faubrey, I’ll become an even stronger dragon than I was before, nano.”
“Previous loop?”

“That’s right, nano. Gaelion is a Dragon Emperor who knows the future thanks to hitching a ride on the Spear Hero’s loop. I originally planned to work with Naofumi and the others to save everyone, but the Spear Hero shoved me aside to protect his position, nano.”
At Rival’s words, everyone—including Father—glared at me. What’s the meaning of this? I did nothing wrong!
“Motoyasu-kun?”
“He’s an enemy trying to take Father’s virginity!”
“I get that… but… sigh… well, it’s Motoyasu, and it looks like the other party knew what they were getting into, so I guess it’s fine.”
“Nano, nano, nano! I’ll definitely take Naofumi’s virginity one day, nano!”
At an incredibly high tension, Rival clung to Father’s arm and pressed its chest against him. Guh, that shameless hussy!
